_comment: Shared listing copy for every directory. Keep in sync with server.json and the Apify Store page.
name: Document to Markdown
tagline: PDF, Word, Excel, CSV and HTML files to LLM-ready markdown with tables, page markers and optional RAG chunks.
description: Give it document URLs (or base64 files); get one JSON row per document with markdown (headings, lists, GFM tables from DOCX/XLSX), <!-- page N --> markers for PDFs, optional chunks with heading and page, page counts, status and errorCode. Type detected from file bytes. Pay per event via Apify: $0.001 per page (PDF page, or 3,000 characters of other formats), $0.001 run start (batch only). Failed documents are never charged.
whenToChoose: You need to read PDFs, Word or Excel files an agent found by URL.
You need RAG chunks with heading and page number per chunk, sized by chunkSize/chunkOverlap.
You need a token budget: maxChars and pages limit output and cost.
You need clear failures: NO_TEXT_LAYER (scanned PDF), ENCRYPTED, UNSUPPORTED_TYPE, HTTP errors come back as free error rows.
chooseAnotherToolWhen: Scanned PDFs that need OCR, PowerPoint files, pixel-accurate PDF table extraction (PDF tables come out as text lines).
auth: OAuth (sign in with Apify) or header Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>
